The code here: gaps = [0.0] + [diffs]; cut = gaps.index(max(gaps)); return ranked[:cut]. If max gap is 0.0 (the initial), cut=0 → empty selection. That corresponds to single candidate all-empty behavior (when there's only one candidate, gaps=[0.0], max=0.0, cut=0, return [] — empty). The user said "保持原最大gap规则（单候选可能全空，本轮不修复）" — the single-candidate case may produce empty output, not fixed this round. So gap_select replicates that.
